note: Independent rejudgment of all 9 tagged units (5 positive, 4 negative) against RFC 8654 Sections 5-6 and RFC 4271 Sections 6-6.1. Header unit tests (header_test.go::TestValidateLengthWithMax positive/negative and rfc8654_length_bounds_test.go::TestRFC8654LengthBoundsPerTypeAndCapability) pin exact per-type length bounds with and without Extended Message and assert exact Message Header Error / Bad Message Length (1/2) Notifications carrying the 2-octet erroneous Length in Data. Live TCP session tests (rfc8654_bad_length_session_test.go::TestRFC8654OverLengthUpdateFollowsRFC4271ErrorHandling, rfc8654_fatal_length_cleanup_test.go::TestRFC8654FatalLengthReleasesInstalledRoutes, and rfc8654_fatal_length_cleanup_test.go::TestRFC8654ValidLengthRetainsInstalledRoutes) establish real Adj-RIB-In, Loc-RIB and recipient TCP state, trigger pre-body rejection of Length 4097 without capability 6, verify exact Notification 1/2 Data 0x1001 followed by TCP EOF, Idle transition, timer/context/negotiated-capability deallocation, Adj-RIB-In/Loc-RIB clearance and downstream withdrawals, and confirm an adjacent valid 4096-octet UPDATE retains the session and routes and forwards its changed MED without Notification or withdrawal. rfc8654_rib_recovery_test.go::TestRFC8654FatalLengthReelectsAlternateBest proves single-change Loc-RIB replacement (ChangeUpdate) and exact alternate AS_PATH/NEXT_HOP delivery on recipient TCP through a causal post-recovery marker without transient withdrawal, while withdrawing routes with no survivor. The prior partial gap (RFC 4271 Section 6 owner-release ordering through outbound admission) is now closed on both forwarding architectures for withdraw-only and alternate-best teardowns by rfc8654_fatal_owner_order_test.go::TestRFC8654FatalLengthHoldsRouteOwnerUntilRecoveryAdmission (RS mode: pauses recipient outbound admission at fwdBatchHandler and proves recipient adjOut ownership, open recovery owed records and bgp-rs's final sourceReceipts lease stay held after synchronous peer-DOWN delivery until admitRecovery completes outbound admission and release only afterward) and rfc8654_fatal_owner_order_test.go::TestRFC8654FatalLengthOrdinaryRIBHoldsSourceOwnerUntilSelectedOutput (ordinary BGP mode without bgp-rs: pauses recipient SelectRoutes and proves recipient adjOut ownership and bgp-rib's final sourceReceipts lease stay held via beginDownSourceHold/finishDownSourceHold/sourceReleaseReady until selected output completes and release only afterward).
